- 只改說明文件,程式沒有變,不必做任何事

- 只改说明文档,程序没有变,不必做任何事
en:
- The docs now make clear that Wiki Agent can run on the same computer as Notetaker Desktop or on a separate always-on one, and works with just a phone too (diagram, How Notetaker Fits Together, README)
- Docs only, no code changes; nothing to do

zh-Hant:

zh-Hans:
- 说明文档新增〈Scribe2MD〉页:能转哪些格式、怎么取得(要自己转文件或用 doc2md 技能就装会议助手电脑版,用 Wiki Agent 的由它安装、自动更新)
- 只改说明文档,程序没有变,不必做任何事
en:
- New Scribe2MD page in the docs: what it converts and how to get it (install Notetaker Desktop to convert files yourself or for the doc2md skill; with Wiki Agent it is installed and updated for you)
- Docs only, no code changes; nothing to do

zh-Hant:
- Windows 安裝時,收件匣那題現在找得到這台電腦的 OneDrive,預設的收件資料夾直接帶出來(上一版找不到、要自己貼路徑)
- 已經裝好的不必做任何事,照舊運作
zh-Hans:
- Windows 安装时,收件箱那题现在找得到这台电脑的 OneDrive,默认的收件文件夹直接带出来(上一版找不到、要自己贴路径)
- 已经装好的不必做任何事,照旧运作
en:
- On Windows, the inbox question in the installer now finds this PC's OneDrive and suggests the inbox folder (the previous version couldn't find it, so you had to paste the path)
- If you're already set up there is nothing to do; it keeps working as before

zh-Hant:
- 收件匣可以用 Google 雲端硬碟了(給 Android 的會議助手用):安裝時先說明「看你用什麼送檔」——iPhone 用 iCloud 雲碟、Android 用 Google 雲端硬碟,會議助手電腦版在 Windows 首選 OneDrive、在 Mac 首選 iCloud 雲碟;iCloud 雲碟、OneDrive、Google 雲端硬碟可以選好幾個,沒選的不會去看
- Google 雲端硬碟裡的 Google 文件、試算表、簡報捷徑檔(.gdoc、.gsheet 等)不會被收走
- 已經裝好的不必做任何事,照舊運作;要加收 Google 雲端硬碟,先裝「Google 雲端硬碟電腦版」並登入,再照安裝說明重跑一次安裝程式,問「沿用這份(不重填)?」時回 n 重填
zh-Hans:
- 收件箱可以用 Google 云端硬盘了(给 Android 的会议助手用):安装时先说明「看你用什么送文件」——iPhone 用 iCloud 云盘、Android 用 Google 云端硬盘,会议助手电脑版在 Windows 首选 OneDrive、在 Mac 首选 iCloud 云盘;iCloud 云盘、OneDrive、Google 云端硬盘可以选好几个,没选的不会去看
- Google 云端硬盘里的 Google 文档、表格、幻灯片的快捷方式文件(.gdoc、.gsheet 等)不会被收走
- 已经装好的不必做任何事,照旧运作;要加收 Google 云端硬盘,先装「Google 云端硬盘电脑版」并登录,再照安装说明重跑一次安装程序,问「沿用这份(不重填)?」时回 n 重填
en:
- The inbox can now be in Google Drive (for the Notetaker app on Android): the installer first explains which one to watch depending on what sends the files — iPhone uses iCloud Drive, Android uses Google Drive, Notetaker Desktop prefers OneDrive on Windows and iCloud Drive on Mac; you can pick any of iCloud Drive, OneDrive and Google Drive, and the ones you don't pick are not watched
- Google Docs, Sheets and Slides shortcut files in Google Drive (.gdoc, .gsheet and so on) are left alone
- If you're already set up there is nothing to do; it keeps working as before. To add Google Drive, install "Google Drive for desktop" and sign in, then run the installer again as described in the install guide and answer n to "Keep this one (don't fill it in again)?"

zh-Hant:
- 〈會議助手全套服務架構〉的架構圖重畫:分層標色、深色模式也看得清楚
- 只改說明文件,你的電腦照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans:
- 〈会议助手全套服务架构〉的架构图重画:分层标色、深色模式也看得清楚
- 只改说明文档,你的电脑照旧运作,不必做任何事
en:
- The diagram in "How Notetaker Fits Together" is redrawn: each level has its own color, and it reads well in dark mode too
- Documentation only: your computer works as before, and there is nothing to do

zh-Hant:
- 新增說明〈會議助手全套服務架構〉:一張架構圖講清楚手機上的會議助手 App、會議助手電腦版、Scribe2MD 與 Wiki Agent 怎麼串起來,分三層,要多少裝多少;README 開頭也連過去
- 只改說明文件,你的電腦照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans:
- 新增说明〈会议助手全套服务架构〉:一张架构图讲清楚手机上的会议助手 App、会议助手电脑版、Scribe2MD 与 Wiki Agent 怎么串起来,分三层,要多少装多少;README 开头也链接过去
- 只改说明文档,你的电脑照旧运作,不必做任何事
en:
- New guide, "How Notetaker Fits Together": one diagram showing how the Notetaker app on your phone, Notetaker Desktop, Scribe2MD and Wiki Agent connect, in three levels so you install only as much as you need; the README links to it near the top
- Documentation only: your computer works as before, and there is nothing to do

zh-Hant:
- 裝了 Scribe2MD 的話:錄音逐字稿認得繁中、簡中、英文三種寫法,英文、簡中的會議也能正確判斷空白錄音、列出還沒命名的講者
- 英文介面轉出的空白掃描、沒字的圖片,現在會正確標成捨棄候選,不再整份交給 Claude 處理;英文文件裡剛好有「Speaker diagnostics」這種標題時,不會再被誤標成捨棄候選
- 語音辨識卡在重複迴圈、只剩異常標記的錄音也會標出來,理由寫明請對照原始錄音,不會說成「沒有文字」
- 你的電腦照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans:
- 装了 Scribe2MD 的话:录音逐字稿认得繁中、简中、英文三种写法,英文、简中的会议也能正确判断空白录音、列出还没命名的讲者
- 英文界面转出的空白扫描、没字的图片,现在会正确标成舍弃候选,不再整份交给 Claude 处理;英文文件里刚好有「Speaker diagnostics」这种标题时,不会再被误标成舍弃候选
- 语音识别卡在重复循环、只剩异常标记的录音也会标出来,理由写明请对照原始录音,不会说成「没有文字」
- 你的电脑照旧运作,不必做任何事
en:
- With Scribe2MD installed: transcripts are read correctly in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English, so empty recordings and unnamed speakers are detected for English and Simplified Chinese meetings too
- Blank scans and images without text converted under the English interface are now marked as discard candidates instead of being sent to Claude in full; an English document that happens to have a heading like "Speaker diagnostics" is no longer wrongly marked as a discard candidate
- Recordings where speech recognition got stuck in a repeating loop, leaving only the problem markers, are now flagged too, with a reason that says to check the original recording rather than "no text"
- Your computer works as before; there is nothing to do

zh-Hant:
- 把錄音、文件轉成文字的引擎改叫 Scribe2MD,改由 wiki-agent 提供下載:安裝程式會問「要下載安裝 Scribe2MD 嗎?」,不必再到別的網站下載、自己解壓縮。之前裝的舊版 scribe2md 照常能用;裝了 Scribe2MD 之後會自動改用它,之後也會跟著自動更新
- 電腦版改名「會議助手電腦版」(Notetaker Desktop),iPhone App 是「會議助手」;安裝時的問句改成「聲紋同步資料夾」,資料夾 _ScribeSync 不變
- 你的電腦照舊運作,不必做任何事;還沒裝轉寫引擎、想轉錄音的話,再跑一次安裝、問要不要下載 Scribe2MD 時回 y
zh-Hans:
- 把录音、文件转成文字的引擎改叫 Scribe2MD,改由 wiki-agent 提供下载:安装程序会问「要下载安装 Scribe2MD 吗?」,不必再到别的网站下载、自己解压缩。之前装的旧版 scribe2md 照常能用;装了 Scribe2MD 之后会自动改用它,之后也会跟着自动更新
- 电脑版改名「会议助手电脑版」(Notetaker Desktop),iPhone App 是「会议助手」;安装时的问句改成「声纹同步文件夹」,文件夹 _ScribeSync 不变
- 你的电脑照旧运作,不必做任何事;还没装转写引擎、想转录音的话,再跑一次安装、问要不要下载 Scribe2MD 时回 y
en:
- The engine that turns recordings and documents into text is now called Scribe2MD and is downloaded through wiki-agent: the installer asks "Download and install Scribe2MD?", so there is no separate website to download from and nothing to unzip yourself. An older scribe2md you already installed keeps working; once Scribe2MD is installed it is used automatically and kept up to date
- The desktop app is now Notetaker Desktop and the iPhone app is Notetaker; the installer's question now says "Voiceprint sync folder", and the _ScribeSync folder stays the same
- Your computer works as before; there is nothing to do. If you haven't installed a transcription engine and want recordings transcribed, run the installer again and answer y when it offers to download Scribe2MD

zh-Hant: - 內部調整:作者自己那台的公司收件匣在斷網剛恢復時不再誤報金鑰被拒;自動修理讀取查證結果的那句話改成跟警示同一個語系。你的電腦照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 内部调整:作者自己那台的公司收件匣在断网刚恢复时不再误报密钥被拒;自动修理读取查证结果的那句话改成跟警示同一个语系。你的电脑照旧运作,不必做任何事
en: - Internal change: the author's own company inbox no longer falsely reports a rejected key right after the network comes back; automatic repair now reads the check result in the same language as the alert. Your computer works as before; there is nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 內部調整:只改了作者自己那台的公司收件匣(GitHub 出事時不再誤報金鑰被拒);你的電腦沒有這個收件匣、也不跑這段,照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 内部调整:只改了作者自己那台的公司收件匣(GitHub 出事时不再误报密钥被拒);你的电脑没有这个收件匣、也不跑这段,照旧运作,不必做任何事
en: - Internal change: only the author's own company inbox was changed (no more false "key rejected" alerts while GitHub has an outage); your computer has no such inbox and does not run this code, so nothing changes and there is nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 內部調整:只改了作者自己那台的看門狗(iCloud 上傳卡住時的自動修理);你的電腦沒有探針、也不跑這段,照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 内部调整:只改了作者自己那台的看门狗(iCloud 上传卡住时的自动修理);你的电脑没有探针、也不跑这段,照旧运作,不必做任何事
en: - Internal change: only the author's own machine's watchdog was changed (automatic repair when iCloud uploads get stuck); your computer has no probe and does not run this code, so nothing changes and there is nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 攝入時要核對原件資料夾裡的舊版 Office 檔(.doc／.xls／.ppt,例如上一版),office-dump 會先用 LibreOffice 轉好再印出原文,不再說不支援;電腦上要有 LibreOffice(Windows 上 scribe2md 自己下載的那份也找得到),沒有就照舊以轉寫為準。沒裝 scribe2md 的,舊版 Office 檔照舊留在待處理
zh-Hans: - 摄入时要核对原件文件夹里的旧版 Office 文件(.doc／.xls／.ppt,例如上一版),office-dump 会先用 LibreOffice 转好再打印原文,不再说不支持;电脑上要有 LibreOffice(Windows 上 scribe2md 自己下载的那份也找得到),没有就照旧以转写为准。没装 scribe2md 的,旧版 Office 文件照旧留在待处理
en: - When an ingest needs to check a legacy Office file in the originals folder (.doc/.xls/.ppt, for example the previous version), office-dump now converts it with LibreOffice first and prints the original text instead of saying the format is not supported. LibreOffice must be on the computer (on Windows the copy scribe2md downloads itself is found too); without it the transcript is used as before. Without scribe2md, legacy Office files still stay in the pending folder

zh-Hant: - 內部調整,單一知識庫沒有變化:新增的「重產群組 README」只用在庫裡有對應腳本的兩庫設定;你的設定照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 内部调整,单一知识库没有变化:新增的「重新生成分组 README」只用在库里有对应脚本的两库设置;你的设置照旧运作,不必做任何事
en: - Internal changes; nothing changes for a single knowledge base: the new "regenerate group READMEs" step only applies to the two-repo setup whose repo has the matching script. Your setup keeps working as before; nothing to do

zh-Hant:
- 表格加總(table-sums)認得分隔列寫成 `--:` 這種只有兩個減號的表,不再回「沒有表格」
- 攝入時要跟原件資料夾裡別份 Office 原件(例如上一版)比對,提示講明同一個傾印指令換成那份的路徑就能讀,不再以為只能讀這一份
- `wiki-feeder tool-gaps` 指令列出全部缺口(摘要信照舊最多列 8 項)
- log 的用量那行,「呼叫 N 次、最大一次上下文」改成「結束時上下文」(原本的數字其實只是最後一次呼叫)
zh-Hans:
- 表格加总(table-sums)认得分隔行写成 `--:` 这种只有两个减号的表,不再回「没有表格」
- 摄入时要跟原件文件夹里别份 Office 原件(例如上一版)比对,提示讲明同一个导出命令换成那份的路径就能读,不再以为只能读这一份
- `wiki-feeder tool-gaps` 命令列出全部缺口(摘要邮件照旧最多列 8 项)
- log 的用量那行,「调用 N 次、最大一次上下文」改成「结束时上下文」(原本的数字其实只是最后一次调用)
en:
- table-sums now recognises tables whose separator row uses only two hyphens, such as `--:`, instead of reporting "no tables"
- When an ingest needs to compare with another Office original in the originals folder (for example the previous version), the prompt now says the same dump command works with that file's path, so it no longer assumes only the current file can be read
- `wiki-feeder tool-gaps` lists every gap (the summary email still lists at most 8)
- In the usage line of the log, "N calls, largest context" became "context at end" (the number was only ever the last call)

zh-Hant:
- 要你處理的信更醒目:主旨開頭改成「🚨 需要處理 N 件」(寫出有幾件),信裡的「失敗與警示」移到最前面,不再排在已攝入的檔後面、被當成一般的攝入完成通知。自動更新失敗的信主旨也改用 🚨
- 攝入一份檔用完每筆的預算、沒交回報時,警示會寫出這份花了多少、每筆上限多少,方便判斷上限要不要調
- 每筆攝入在 log 多記一行用量(各類 token、呼叫次數、最大一次上下文、網路抓取、子代理、各模型花費),查得出額度花在哪。用訂閱登入的話,這裡的金額是照定價換算的估計,不是帳單
zh-Hans:
- 要你处理的邮件更醒目:主题开头改成「🚨 需要处理 N 件」(写出有几件),邮件里的「失败与警示」移到最前面,不再排在已摄入的文件后面、被当成一般的摄入完成通知。自动更新失败的邮件主题也改用 🚨
- 摄入一份文件用完每笔的预算、没交回报时,警示会写出这份花了多少、每笔上限多少,方便判断上限要不要调
- 每笔摄入在 log 多记一行用量(各类 token、调用次数、最大一次上下文、网络抓取、子代理、各模型花费),查得出额度花在哪。用订阅登录的话,这里的金额是按定价换算的估计,不是账单
en:
- Emails that need you stand out more: the subject now starts with "🚨 Needs attention (N)" (with the count), and "Failures and alerts" moves to the top of the email instead of sitting after the ingested files, where it read like an ordinary ingest-done notice. Auto-update failure emails use 🚨 too
- When an ingest runs out of its per-item budget without handing back a report, the alert now says how much it cost and what the per-item limit is, so you can decide whether to raise it
- Each ingest logs one more line with usage (token types, number of calls, largest context, web fetches, subagents, cost per model), so you can see where the quota went. If you sign in with a subscription, that amount is an estimate at list price, not a bill

zh-Hant:
- scribe2md 改成選裝(它是省 token 用的):沒裝時 PDF、照片、Word／Excel／PowerPoint、EPUB、TIFF／BMP 攝入時由 Claude 直接讀(較花 token;Office 文件裡的圖讀不到);錄音、影片(以及舊版 .doc／.xls／.ppt、Outlook .msg、Windows 上的 HEIC)留在待處理資料夾、摘要信每天提醒一次「要裝 scribe2md 才會處理」,裝好後再跑一次安裝程式填路徑,下一輪自動處理。安裝程式找不到 scribe2md 時改問「有裝嗎?」,沒裝直接 Enter。已經裝好 scribe2md 的不必做任何事
- 建庫提示詞裡「我的電腦裝了 doc2md 轉檔 Skill」那一條改成「二進位檔由 wiki-feeder 先轉、它說沒有轉寫的才直接讀原件」,只影響新建的知識庫
zh-Hans:
- scribe2md 改成选装(它是省 token 用的):没装时 PDF、照片、Word／Excel／PowerPoint、EPUB、TIFF／BMP 摄入时由 Claude 直接读(较花 token;Office 文件里的图读不到);录音、视频(以及旧版 .doc／.xls／.ppt、Outlook .msg、Windows 上的 HEIC)留在待处理文件夹、摘要邮件每天提醒一次「要装 scribe2md 才会处理」,装好后再跑一次安装程序填路径,下一轮自动处理。安装程序找不到 scribe2md 时改问「有装吗?」,没装直接 Enter。已经装好 scribe2md 的不必做任何事
- 建库提示词里「我的电脑装了 doc2md 转换 Skill」那一条改成「二进制文件由 wiki-feeder 先转、它说没有转写的才直接读原件」,只影响新建的知识库
en:
- scribe2md is now optional (it is there to save tokens): without it, Claude reads PDFs, photos, Word/Excel/PowerPoint, EPUB and TIFF/BMP directly at ingest time (using more tokens; pictures inside Office files are not seen); recordings and video (and old .doc/.xls/.ppt, Outlook .msg, HEIC on Windows) wait in the pending folder and the daily summary reminds you once a day that scribe2md is needed; install it, run the installer again to give the path, and the next round handles them. When the installer cannot find scribe2md it now asks whether it is installed; just press Enter if not. If you already have scribe2md, nothing to do
- In the knowledge-base setup prompt, the line "my computer has the doc2md conversion Skill" became "binary files are converted first by wiki-feeder; read the original only when it says there is no transcription"; affects newly created knowledge bases only

zh-Hant:
- 手機與電腦共用聲紋、名詞對照表的資料夾改成安裝時自己選:安裝程式多問一題「【scribe2md 同步資料夾】有做安裝說明第 7 節嗎?」,建議名是英文的 `_ScribeSync`,不再固定用 iCloud 雲碟裡的 `_聲紋同步`。**有做第 7 節的**:再跑一次安裝程式、問「沿用這份(不重填)?」回 n 重填、在那一題填你的資料夾(可以就是原來的 `_聲紋同步`),名詞對照表才會繼續更新;沒做第 7 節的不必做任何事
- 內部調整:程式裡幾個固定檔名改成英文,你的設定照舊運作
zh-Hans:
- 手机与电脑共用声纹、名词对照表的文件夹改成安装时自己选:安装程序多问一题「【scribe2md 同步文件夹】有做安装说明第 7 节吗?」,建议名是英文的 `_ScribeSync`,不再固定用 iCloud 云盘里的 `_聲紋同步`。**有做第 7 节的**:再跑一次安装程序、问「沿用这份(不重填)?」回 n 重填、在那一题填你的文件夹(可以就是原来的 `_聲紋同步`),名词对照表才会继续更新;没做第 7 节的不必做任何事
- 内部调整:程序里几个固定文件名改成英文,你的设置照旧运作
en:
- The folder that phone and computer share for voiceprints and the name-correction table is now chosen at install time: the installer asks one more question, `[scribe2md sync folder] Did you do step 7 of the guide …?`, and suggests the English name `_ScribeSync` instead of always using `_聲紋同步` in iCloud Drive. **If you did step 7**: run the installer again, answer n to keeping the current settings, and give your folder at that question (it can stay the old `_聲紋同步`); otherwise the name-correction table stops updating. If you never did step 7, nothing to do
- Internal change: a few fixed file names inside the program are now English; your setup works as before

zh-Hant: - 內部調整,單一知識庫沒有變化:兩台電腦同時推送、索引頁撞在一起時的自動合併多收了一種情形,只用在有「最近異動」區塊的兩庫設定;你的設定照舊運作,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 内部调整,单一知识库没有变化:两台电脑同时推送、索引页撞在一起时的自动合并多收了一种情形,只用在有「最近异动」区块的两库设定;你的设定照旧运作,不必做任何事
en: - Internal change, nothing changes for a single knowledge base: automatic merging when two computers push at the same time and the index page collides now covers one more case, used only by two-library setups that keep a "recent changes" section; your setup works as before, nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 推送知識庫更穩:推送被拒時改成先 `fetch` 再 `rebase` 到遠端分支(不再用 `git pull`),網路閃斷、檔案鎖住這類暫時的失敗會等幾秒自動重試,用完次數也只是下一輪再推,不再寄「待人處理」;你自己正在處理 rebase 時程式不會打斷你。只有把知識庫接到 GitHub、又在別台電腦也會推的才碰得到;只用本機的不受影響,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 推送知识库更稳:推送被拒时改成先 `fetch` 再 `rebase` 到远端分支(不再用 `git pull`),网络闪断、文件锁住这类暂时的失败会等几秒自动重试,用完次数也只是下一轮再推,不再寄「待人处理」;你自己正在处理 rebase 时程序不会打断你。只有把知识库接到 GitHub、又在别台电脑也会推的才碰得到;只用本机的不受影响,不必做任何事
en: - More reliable knowledge-base pushes: when a push is rejected, the program now runs `fetch` and then `rebase` onto the remote branch (no more `git pull`). Temporary failures such as a network blip or a locked file are retried automatically after a few seconds, and if the retries run out the push simply happens next round instead of mailing "needs attention"; a rebase you are doing yourself is never interrupted. This only matters if your knowledge base is connected to GitHub and also pushed from another computer; local-only setups are unaffected, nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 安裝問答與安裝說明不再提「講義」(你手上沒有那份講義):問知識庫位置時直接說明 `WIKI` 資料夾是什麼——知識庫本體,放規則檔 `CLAUDE.md` 與整理好的筆記,旁邊並排的 `Raw_Sources` 放原始資料;資料夾長什麼樣子,看〈什麼是 LLM Wiki〉的「知識庫長什麼樣子?」。Windows 與 Mac 都一樣;已安裝的不受影響,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 安装问答与安装说明不再提「讲义」(你手上没有那份讲义):问知识库位置时直接说明 `WIKI` 文件夹是什么——知识库本体,放规则文件 `CLAUDE.md` 与整理好的笔记,旁边并排的 `Raw_Sources` 放原始资料;文件夹长什么样子,看〈什么是 LLM Wiki〉的「知识库长什么样子?」。Windows 与 Mac 都一样;已安装的不受影响,不必做任何事
en: - The setup questions and install guides no longer mention the "handout" (you don't have it): when asking where the knowledge base goes, setup now explains what the `WIKI` folder is — the knowledge base itself, holding the rules file `CLAUDE.md` and the organized notes, with `Raw_Sources` beside it for the original material; to see the folder layout, read "What does the knowledge base look like?" in What is LLM Wiki. Same on Windows and Mac; existing installs are unaffected, nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 只跟 Windows 有關:「文件」「桌面」被 OneDrive 接管(開了 OneDrive 資料夾備份)時,放在本機 `C:\Users\<帳號>\Documents` 的知識庫不會再被提醒成在同步資料夾裡——那時檔案總管的「文件」其實在 `OneDrive\文件`,`C:\Users\<帳號>\Documents` 是另一個不會被同步的本機資料夾;安裝說明補上怎麼從檔案總管的網址列看完整路徑、確認資料夾在不在 OneDrive。Mac 沒有變化。不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 只跟 Windows 有关:「文档」「桌面」被 OneDrive 接管(开了 OneDrive 文件夹备份)时,放在本机 `C:\Users\<账号>\Documents` 的知识库不会再被提醒成在同步文件夹里——那时文件总管的「文档」其实在 `OneDrive\文档`,`C:\Users\<账号>\Documents` 是另一个不会被同步的本机文件夹;安装说明补上怎么从文件总管的网址列看完整路径、确认文件夹在不在 OneDrive。Mac 没有变化。不必做任何事
en: - Windows only: when OneDrive has taken over Documents and Desktop (OneDrive folder backup is on), a knowledge base in the local `C:\Users\<name>\Documents` is no longer flagged as being in a sync folder — in that case File Explorer's Documents actually lives at `OneDrive\Documents`, and `C:\Users\<name>\Documents` is a different local folder that is not synced; the install guide now explains how to check the full path in File Explorer's address bar to see whether a folder is in OneDrive. Nothing changes on a Mac. Nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 安裝時,知識庫或原件資料夾放在 OneDrive、iCloud 雲碟、Dropbox、Google Drive(或被同步的「文件」「桌面」)裡會提醒你、說明原因,建議換到家目錄的 LLMWiki;堅持要放的話,看完後果打 yes,知識庫的版本紀錄(git)會改放在這台電腦、不放在同步資料夾裡;已安裝的不受影響
zh-Hans: - 安装时,知识库或原件文件夹放在 OneDrive、iCloud 云盘、Dropbox、Google Drive(或被同步的「文稿」「桌面」)里会提醒你、说明原因,建议换到家目录的 LLMWiki;坚持要放的话,看完后果打 yes,知识库的版本记录(git)会改放在这台电脑、不放在同步文件夹里;已安装的不受影响
en: - Setup now warns you, and explains why, when the knowledge base or originals folder is inside OneDrive, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive (or a synced Documents / Desktop), and suggests LLMWiki in your home folder instead; if you insist, read the consequences and type yes — the knowledge base's version history (git) is then kept on this computer instead of in the sync folder; existing installs are unaffected

zh-Hant: - 新安裝的知識庫預設改放家目錄的 LLMWiki(Windows `%USERPROFILE%\LLMWiki\WIKI`、Mac `~/LLMWiki/WIKI`),不放「文件」「桌面」,免得被 OneDrive／iCloud 同步弄壞;已安裝的不變
zh-Hans: - 新安装的知识库默认改放家目录的 LLMWiki(Windows `%USERPROFILE%\LLMWiki\WIKI`、Mac `~/LLMWiki/WIKI`),不放「文档」「桌面」,免得被 OneDrive／iCloud 同步弄坏;已安装的不变
en: - New installs now create the knowledge base in LLMWiki in your home folder (Windows `%USERPROFILE%\LLMWiki\WIKI`, Mac `~/LLMWiki/WIKI`) rather than Documents or Desktop, where OneDrive/iCloud syncing can corrupt it; existing installs are unchanged

zh-Hant:
- 安裝時先問「你已經有 LLM Wiki 了嗎?」:有的話只要指出 CLAUDE.md,原件資料夾與新檔入口照它寫的自動找出來(入口資料夾叫什麼都可以),確認一次就好,不必一題一題答;已經裝好的不受影響
- 安裝一開始就先選語言,之後的畫面只用你選的語言(原本裝 git、uv 那幾步照電腦的系統語言,會中英文混在一起)
zh-Hans:
- 安装时先问「你已经有 LLM Wiki 了吗?」:有的话只要指出 CLAUDE.md,原件文件夹与新文件入口照它写的自动找出来(入口文件夹叫什么都可以),确认一次就好,不必一题一题答;已经装好的不受影响
- 安装一开始就先选语言,之后的画面只用你选的语言(原本装 git、uv 那几步照电脑的系统语言,会中英文混在一起)
en:
- Setup now starts by asking whether you already have an LLM Wiki: if so, just point to its CLAUDE.md and the originals folder and inbox are read from it (the inbox folder can have any name) — one confirmation instead of a question for each; existing installs are unaffected
- Setup asks for the language at the very start, and every screen after that uses only the language you chose (before, the git and uv steps followed the computer's system language, so languages were mixed)

zh-Hant: - 內部調整:只跟「公事、個人兩個知識庫一起用」的設定有關;安裝問答建的是單一知識庫,你這邊的行為沒有任何變化,不必做什麼
zh-Hans: - 内部调整:只跟「公事、个人两个知识库一起用」的设置有关;安装问答建的是单一知识库,你这边的行为没有任何变化,不必做什么
en: - Internal change that only affects setups using two wikis (work and personal) together; the setup wizard creates a single wiki, so nothing changes for you and there is nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 雲端收件匣(例如 OneDrive)正在同步時偶爾會讀不到一次,以前會立刻寄「需要處理」的信、打開電腦看卻一切正常;現在跟沒有權限一樣,連續 3 輪讀不到才提醒
zh-Hans: - 云端收件箱(例如 OneDrive)正在同步时偶尔会读不到一次,以前会立刻发「需要处理」的邮件、打开电脑看却一切正常;现在跟没有权限一样,连续 3 轮读不到才提醒
en: - A cloud inbox (such as OneDrive) can briefly fail to be read while it is syncing. This used to send a "Needs attention" email right away even though everything was fine; now, as with a missing permission, you are only alerted after 3 rounds in a row fail

zh-Hant: - 〈什麼是 LLM Wiki〉的「規則檔 CLAUDE.md 裡寫了什麼」改成一份可以整段複製的 CLAUDE.md 範例(不再是表格),想自己寫規則檔的可以直接貼來改
zh-Hans: - 〈什么是 LLM Wiki〉的「规则文件 CLAUDE.md 里写了什么」改成一份可以整段复制的 CLAUDE.md 示例(不再是表格),想自己写规则文件的可以直接贴来改
en: - In "What is an LLM Wiki?", "What's in the rules file, CLAUDE.md?" is now a sample CLAUDE.md you can copy in one go (instead of a table), ready to paste into your own rules file and edit

zh-Hant:
- 手機 scribe2md 的「送進知識庫」模式產生會議草稿時,會用**名詞對照表**把語音辨識聽錯的人名、公司、術語換成正確寫法。對照表不用另外維護:看到會議頁寫錯,跟 Claude 說哪場會議、哪裡錯、正確是什麼,它改頁面時順手記下來,wiki-agent 每一輪攝入完自動放進 iCloud 雲碟的 `_聲紋同步`。安裝時會問要不要在 CLAUDE.md 補上這條規則,說法的例子見安裝說明第 7 節
- 安裝說明第 7 節:「送進知識庫」模式已經不用開通密碼
- 〈什麼是 LLM Wiki〉新增「規則檔 CLAUDE.md 裡寫了什麼」:角色、收件分類、工作流程、品質標準(不用 Obsidian、一律標準 Markdown 連結)等,以及規則檔可以請 Claude 改
zh-Hans:
- 手机 scribe2md 的「送进知识库」模式生成会议草稿时,会用**名词对照表**把语音识别听错的人名、公司、术语换成正确写法。对照表不用另外维护:看到会议页写错,跟 Claude 说哪场会议、哪里错、正确是什么,它改页面时顺手记下来,wiki-agent 每一轮摄入完自动放进 iCloud 云盘的 `_聲紋同步`。安装时会问要不要在 CLAUDE.md 补上这条规则,说法的例子见安装说明第 7 节
- 安装说明第 7 节:「送进知识库」模式已经不用开通密码
- 〈什么是 LLM Wiki〉新增「规则文件 CLAUDE.md 里写了什么」:角色、收件分类、工作流程、质量标准(不用 Obsidian、一律标准 Markdown 链接)等,以及规则文件可以请 Claude 改
en:
- When the scribe2md phone app drafts meeting notes in "send to knowledge base" mode, it now uses a **name-correction table** to fix names, companies and terms that speech recognition got wrong. You don't maintain the table yourself: when a meeting page has something wrong, tell Claude which meeting, what is wrong and what is right; it fixes the page and records the correction, and after each ingest round wiki-agent puts the table into `_聲紋同步` in iCloud Drive. Installation asks whether to add this rule to CLAUDE.md; see section 7 of the install guide for example phrasings
- Install guide section 7: "send to knowledge base" mode no longer needs an activation password
- "What is an LLM Wiki?" now has "What's in the rules file, CLAUDE.md?": the role, intake and filing, workflows, quality standards (no Obsidian; standard Markdown links only) and more, and that you can ask Claude to change the rules

zh-Hant:
- 新安裝時,原件資料夾底下的系統資料夾改用英文名稱:`_Pending`(待處理)、`_Discarded`(捨棄候選)、`_Inbox`(收件區),每種語言都一樣。已經在用的知識庫照舊用原來的中文名稱,不受影響,不必做任何事
- 〈什麼是 LLM Wiki〉的「知識庫長什麼樣子」加上資料夾架構圖
zh-Hans:
- 新安装时,原件文件夹底下的系统文件夹改用英文名称:`_Pending`(待处理)、`_Discarded`(舍弃候选)、`_Inbox`(收件区),每种语言都一样。已经在用的知识库照旧用原来的中文名称,不受影响,不必做任何事
- 〈什么是 LLM Wiki〉的「知识库长什么样子」加上文件夹架构图
en:
- New installs now name the system folders under the sources folder in English, the same for every language: `_Pending`, `_Discarded` and `_Inbox`. Knowledge bases already in use keep their existing folder names and are not affected, so there is nothing to do
- Added a folder diagram to "What does the knowledge base look like?" in "What is an LLM Wiki?"

zh-Hant: - 新增說明〈什麼是 LLM Wiki〉(What-is-LLM-Wiki.zh-TW.md),用白話講這套知識庫在做什麼;README 開頭連過去。程式沒有改變,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 新增说明〈什么是 LLM Wiki〉(What-is-LLM-Wiki.zh-CN.md),用白话讲这套知识库在做什么;README 开头链接过去。程序没有改变,不必做任何事
en: - Added a plain-language guide, "What is an LLM Wiki?" (What-is-LLM-Wiki.md), explaining what this knowledge base does; the README links to it at the top. The program is unchanged, so there is nothing to do

zh-Hant: - README 與安裝說明的中文版改名:繁中是 .zh-TW.md、簡中是 .zh-CN.md(原本 .zh-Hant／.zh-Hans),最上面的語言列改成 English | 繁體中文 | 简体中文;舊的連結會打不開,從 README 頁首切換即可。程式沒有改變,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - README 与安装说明的中文版改名:繁中是 .zh-TW.md、简中是 .zh-CN.md(原本 .zh-Hant/.zh-Hans),最上面的语言列改成 English | 繁體中文 | 简体中文;旧的链接会打不开,从 README 页首切换即可。程序没有改变,不必做任何事
en: - The Chinese README and installation guides were renamed: Traditional Chinese is now .zh-TW.md and Simplified Chinese .zh-CN.md (previously .zh-Hant/.zh-Hans), and the language bar at the top now reads English | 繁體中文 | 简体中文; old links to the Chinese files no longer work, so switch from the top of the README. The program is unchanged, so there is nothing to do

zh-Hant: - 更正上一則:那一版除了 README 改成英文預設,程式也有小改——自動更新換某一版失敗過,就不再每天重新下載那一版(Mac 雙擊 App 裝的每次約 29 MB);Mac 的「卡住了」警示改用你實際的安裝位置提示怎麼找 Claude。不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - 更正上一则:那一版除了 README 改成英文默认,程序也有小改——自动更新换某一版失败过,就不再每天重新下载那一版(Mac 双击 App 装的每次约 29 MB);Mac 的「卡住了」警示改用你实际的安装位置提示怎么找 Claude。不必做任何事
en: - Correction to the previous note: besides making the README default to English, that version also included a small program change — if switching to a version has failed once, auto-update no longer downloads that version again every day (about 29 MB each time for the Mac app); on a Mac, the "stuck" alert now uses your actual install location when telling you how to reach Claude. Nothing to do

zh-Hant: - GitHub 頁面的 README 預設改成英文,最上面可以切換繁體中文、簡體中文;程式沒有改變,不必做任何事
zh-Hans: - GitHub 页面的 README 默认改成英文,最上面可以切换繁体中文、简体中文;程序没有改变,不必做任何事
en: - The README on GitHub now defaults to English, with links at the top to switch to Traditional or Simplified Chinese; the program itself is unchanged, so there is nothing to do

zh-Hant:
- Windows:多一個每 3 分鐘的「簡易看門狗」,某一輪卡住、收件或攝入的排程被停用時,會寫進當日摘要的警示
- Windows:可以從安裝包(wiki-agent-win.zip)安裝,Update.bat 會自己下載新版
- Windows 與 Mac:每天查一次新版,最新版發佈滿 1 天就自動更新(等正在處理的那一輪做完才換,換完先試讀,讀不到就自己退回),結果另外寄一封信;Mac 雙擊 App 裝的會自己換上新的 wiki-agent,舊的留著當退路。不想自動更新的話,設定檔 [general] 加 auto_update = false
zh-Hans:
- Windows:多一个每 3 分钟的「简易看门狗」,某一轮卡住、收件或摄入的定时任务被禁用时,会写进当日摘要的警示
- Windows:可以从安装包(wiki-agent-win.zip)安装,Update.bat 会自己下载新版
- Windows 与 Mac:每天查一次新版,最新版发布满 1 天就自动更新(等正在处理的那一轮做完才换,换完先试读,读不到就自己退回),结果另外寄一封邮件;Mac 双击 App 装的会自己换上新的 wiki-agent,旧的留着当退路。不想自动更新的话,设置文件 [general] 加 auto_update = false
en:
- Windows: a new simple watchdog runs every 3 minutes; when a round gets stuck or the collect/ingest schedule is disabled, it adds an alert to the daily summary
- Windows: you can install from the package (wiki-agent-win.zip), and Update.bat downloads new versions by itself
- Windows and Mac: checks once a day and installs the newest version once it has been out for a day (it waits for the round being processed to finish, test-reads afterwards and rolls back by itself if reading fails), and emails you the result separately; on a Mac installed from the app, it swaps in the new wiki-agent by itself and keeps the old one as a fallback. To turn this off, add auto_update = false under [general] in the config file
